    Left tau-sequences for the finite right-module category #

    At a noninjective selected module, the chosen minimal left almost-split monomorphism and its cokernel form the left Auslander--Reiten complex. At an injective selected module, the chosen minimal left almost-split map is epic, so its cokernel is zero. Finite componentwise biproducts extend these meshes to every finitely generated right module.
